## 分诊 — `domain:ui` / `priority:p2` / `pm:queue` **锚定 (anchoring)**：两个 header 分别在 `packages/plugin-detail` 和 `packages/layout`，都在 objectui 的 ui lane（published library）。虽然是两个包、两套 build，但都是 `domain:ui`，一张卡即可，不拆。 ### 在 `origin/main` `a472b07` 上复核的锚点 —— 主张成立，行号已漂移 ⚠️ 卡片写的 `DetailView.tsx:919`，当前是 **`:960-976`**： ``` packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx:959 {schema.showHeader !== false && ( packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx:960
packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx:961
packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx:972
packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx:974

``` 卡片说的两件缺失都实测为真：外层行 `:960` **没有** `flex-wrap`（只有 `sm:flex-row`），title 列 `:961` **没有**宽度下限（只有 `flex-1 min-w-0`）。`:956-958` 的注释也确认了卡片"这是 host 不给 `page:header` 时渲染的那个 header"—— 活路径，不是死代码。 ⚠️ 卡片写的 `PageHeader.tsx:236` **恰好还是 236**： ``` packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx:218
packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx:236
packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx:242 {slot &&
{slot}
} ``` 卡片的"部分免疫"判断也成立：`:218` 已有 `flex-wrap`，但 `:236` 的 title 列仍是 `flex-1`（flex-basis 0，永远不会撑出换行），而 `:242` 的 `slot` 带 `ml-auto` 挤在同一行 —— 同根、较轻。 ### #7244 的修法已经落地，是现成的样板 ``` packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1956 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4 pb-4 border-b', packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1961
``` `:1940-1942` 还留了两条为什么这么改的注释。**正控制**：`sm:min-w-48` 全仓 `git grep -c` = 2，两处都在 `containers.tsx` —— 也就是说 #7244 的修法目前**只此一家**，本卡这两处确实没沾到。 ### 定级理由 `priority:p2`：兄弟现场是**实测**的（799px 视口下 h1 被压到 29.5px），不是推测；`DetailView` 的 header 是 host 不自带 `page:header` 时的默认记录头，覆盖面比 `page:header` 那条更广。没有数据损坏也没有静默错答（视觉可见即可发现），所以不是 p1。 ### 给执行席的注意事项 1. ⚠️ **不要照搬 `sm:min-w-48` 就收工**。卡片自己说清楚了：每处的取值（要不要下限、多少、行要不要 wrap）是那套布局自己的判断。`PageHeader` 那条尤其 —— 它已经 wrap 了，缺的是"title 列贡献宽度"，`min-w` 与把 `flex-1` 换成 `flex-auto`/给 basis 是两种不同的答案。 2. 按卡片的"Suggested check"各做一次浏览器实测（三个以上带标签的 action、约 800px 视口，读 `h1.getBoundingClientRect().width` 对 `h1.scrollWidth`），与 #7244 同法取证 —— 这是卡片作者明说 PR #7244 故意没背的那部分工作，不要再往后推。 3. 两个包 build/test 面不同，允许拆成两个 PR；若拆，第二个 PR 引用本卡而不是新开卡。 ⛔ 分诊席不认领、不派单、不写码。 --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Claim: branch `claude/issue-7281-record-header-width-arbitration`

Clause-②: no

`domain:ui` PM seat, `session_01UzHd6hDYatoDn17BuwKxnZ`, R16. Assignee and this comment are set by the PM on the dev's behalf — the dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and never writes the assignee field.

⚠️ `no` with the reasoning stated, since the rule is 「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」 and a `no` may **not** be revised on delivery: this is a layout change — Tailwind classes on two existing headers. No declared type, registration input, exported symbol, authorable key or accept-set moves in either direction. ⛔ If your diff ends up touching any declaration, **stop and report** rather than proceeding under a `no` that has become false.

## ZONE 1 — what to build

Two headers repeat the width-arbitration hazard objectui#7244 already fixed on `page:header`. The precedent fix was an `sm:min-w-48` floor on the title column plus `sm:flex-wrap` on the row.

**1. `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` — same shape, no protection.** A `flex` row with a `shrink-0` action tail and a `flex-1 min-w-0` title column; the title column, being the only flexible item, absorbs the whole width deficit. objectui#7244 measured the sibling at a 799px viewport: header 687px, tail 641.5px, **h1 left with 29.5px**. ⭐ This is a **live path** — the file's own comment says this header renders when the host does *not* supply a `page:header`.

**2. `packages/layout/src/PageHeader.tsx` — partially protected.** Its outer row already wraps, so the deficit has somewhere to go, but the title column is still `flex-1` with no floor — and `flex-1` means a flex-basis of 0, so the column never contributes width that would force a wrap, and a wide `slot` on the same line still takes the remainder. Milder, same root.

⚠️ Line numbers in the card (`:919`, `:236`) are from **2026-09-02** and are stale by default — re-derive them. ⚠️ And the card is explicit that it was **identified statically, never measured in a browser**: treat its geometry as a claim with a timestamp, not as a reading.

## ZONE 2 — the measurement this card actually turns on

⭐ **This is the deliverable, not a nice-to-have.** The card names the method, and it is the same one objectui#7244 was measured with:

> Drive a record whose header carries **three or more labelled actions** at a viewport around **800px** through each path, and read `h1.getBoundingClientRect().width` against `h1.scrollWidth`.

⚠️ **jsdom and happy-dom report `clientWidth` 0** — a standing lane fact. ⇒ a jsdom assertion about width is **NOT MEASURED**, not a pass. Use the real browser: Chromium is preinstalled at `/opt/pw-browsers` and `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` is already set. ⛔ Never run `playwright install`.

⛔ A scripted scroll or a resize you assert immediately is not a reachability measurement either — let layout settle before reading.

Measure **before** and **after** on both headers. A fix whose before-reading was never taken cannot be shown to have fixed anything.

## ZONE 3 — fences

- ⛔ Two headers only: `DetailView.tsx` and `PageHeader.tsx`. Do not sweep for a third.
- ⛔ Do not touch `containers.tsx` / `page:header` — objectui#7244's surface, already fixed and shipped.
- ⚠️ `packages/plugin-detail` also hosts PR objectui#9058, which is **held** and will rebase later — it touches `RelatedList.tsx` and `renderers/record-related-list.tsx`, ⛔ **not** `DetailView.tsx`. Stay out of those two files and there is no collision.
- ⛔ Do not restructure either header's DOM. The precedent fix was two utility classes; if you find yourself changing the element tree, that is a different card.

## ZONE 4 — stop conditions, each stated as the harm it guards

⭐ Stated as harms deliberately — a stop condition naming a *location* instead of a *harm* cost this lane a round today, and the correction has since paid twice. If a location I give is wrong but the harm is untouched, **keep going and say so in the report**. PM claims are in scope for falsification, and a clean stop on a falsified PM premise is a **full success**.

- **Stop if the browser measurement does not reproduce the hazard on either header.** The harm is shipping a floor nobody needed and calling a statically-guessed bug fixed. Report the readings; a falsified premise here is a full delivery.
- **Stop if a width floor would clip or overflow the action tail at a narrow viewport.** The harm is trading a squeezed title for an unreachable button — strictly worse, since the title at least truncates visibly.
- **Report, don't stop**, if the two headers want *different* floor values. They are different layouts; the card says as much. Say why, per header.

## ZONE 5 — acceptance

- A pin per header asserting the **measured geometry**, not the class string: at the reproducing viewport, `h1.getBoundingClientRect().width` is above the floor and the action tail is fully within the header's box. ⛔ `toHaveClass('sm:min-w-48')` is not acceptance — it would pass against a floor that does nothing.
- The unaffected wide-viewport case is unchanged (regression guard).
- Ablate each floor and show its geometry assertion reds; restore and prove the tree clean **by state** (`git diff HEAD` empty + blob hash back to HEAD's), ⛔ never by an exit code.
